newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q1 MOBILE PHONE WHOLESALES UP 40 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q1 MOBILE PHONE WHOLESALES UP 40 PCT.

text.p: Finnish mobile phones wholesales rose 40 percent in the first quarter of this year, the electronics wholesalers association said on Tuesday.
"A total of 131,500 mobile phones were delivered to retailers in January-March, and growth on the previous year was 40 percent," the association said.
Total household electronics deliveries in January to March amounted to 1.18 billion markka in terms of wholesale prices excluding value-added tax, up 6.5 percent on the previous year, it said.
First-quarter wholesales of mobile phones grew 20 percent in terms of value, to 213 million markka, it said.
The value of January-March wholesales of personal computers for home use rose 15 percent to 225 million markka, it said.
First-quarter wholesales of large home appliances grew 1.8 percent to 265 million markka, it said.
"The home appliance market is expected to grow about 10 percent this year on last year," the association said.
